name: reference.whitelist.entity

list.description: Inspect native entity whitelist settings with optional exact local selection.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Exact local instId match; repeat values for OR and combine fields with AND. Never sent to backend.

parameters.name: financial-code
parameters.description: Exact local instCode match; repeat values for OR and combine fields with AND. Never sent to backend.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact local status match; repeat values for OR and combine fields with AND. Never sent to backend.

purpose: Inspect native whitelist configuration independently of entity directories or settlement agreement whitelists.

fields.name: instId
fields.meaning: Nonblank native entity whitelist record identity.

fields.name: instCode
fields.meaning: Native financial code used by the exact local financial-code filter.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Raw configuration status; VALID/INVALID do not establish operational activation.

fields.name: tntInstId
fields.meaning: Optional native tenant echo; missing or empty string stays unchanged.

identity_description: Native nonblank string instId identifies one entity whitelist record; no derived identity or directory join.
limitations: GET https://iliquidity.alipay.com/instFilterConfigQuery.json carries outer tntInstId=GUAPW3SG and instFilterConfigQuery as a JSON string containing tntInstId, lowercase timezone=GMT+08, rowStart and pageSize. No currentArea or backend business filters are sent.
Qualified zero-based row offsets use widths5000 then1000 under SDK fallback policy. These are verified widths, not measured maximum capacity. No native page echo is assumed.

Both outer resultFlag and inner result.success must be boolean true; inner result.count and outer count must be nonnegative native integers and agree. Full result.data records are retained in native arrival order.

Native totals, arrivals and unique instId counts remain independent evidence. Duplicates, conflicts, count gaps or incomplete pages cannot publish on refresh. No latest-version selection or guessed deduplication key.

Local filters match complete native strings exactly: same-field OR and different-field AND; missing/null never match, commas are not split and * is literal. Blank values reject; accepted strings are not trimmed. Default output retains all native statuses.

Missing or empty native tntInstId remains unchanged; a present value other than empty string or GUAPW3SG is rejected. Unknown/nested fields, precise values, nulls, zero, empty strings and array order remain native.
Only complete nonempty refresh publishes. Live does not publish; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves saved data. No Get, directory/relationship query, mutation or new Duckdog import.

examples.title: Select native financial code and status locally
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list reference.whitelist.entity --financial-code CODE --status VALID
